newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Goodman has new milling, baking head.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Goodman has new milling, baking head.

text.p: Food group Goodman Fielder Ltd said on Monday the head of its milling and baking division Brian Robinson is leaving the company, and will be replaced by Meadow Lea group managing director Phillip Bower.
Goodman Fielder managing director David Hearn said the change continued the restructuring of the company's senior management team.
Robinson and the Goodman Fielder had "mutually agreed that now is the right time to hand over the next phase of development to new management", Goodman Fielder said in a statement.
The milling and baking division accounted for about 23 percent of Goodman Fielder's sales revenue in the six months to December 31, 1996.
Goodman said finance and administration manager of the Meadow Lea group Bruno Fiorentino would co-ordinate the group's management team until a replacement for Bower was appointed.
Robinson had contributed significantly to the company over 23 years and was leaving to pursue other career and business interests, it said.
